name: Cabeza del Caballo (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white, the red charged with a white horse's head and the white with three blue wavy stripes.
history: The municipal flag of Cabeza del Caballo was approved on 8 November 2008, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 13 March 2009; it is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes.

features.role: three wavy stripes on the white
